originals.citation: Hadjikhani, N., Joseph, R. M., et al. (2004). Activation of the fusiform gyrus when individuals with autism spectrum disorder view faces. NeuroImage.

quote: We replicated our original findings of significant activation of face identity-processing areas (FFA and inferior occipital gyrus, IOG) in ASD.
notes: Self-replication; the replication is one component of a paper that mostly reports new findings.
